name: PaginationNav

props.name: disableOverflow
props.description: If true, the '...' pagination overflow will not render page links between the first and last rendered buttons. Set this to true if you are having performance problems with large data sets.

props.name: itemsShown
props.description: The number of items to be shown (minimum of 4 unless props.items < 4).

props.name: loop
props.description: Whether user should be able to loop through the items when reaching first / last.

props.name: size
props.description: Specify the size of the PaginationNav.

props.name: tooltipAlignment
props.description: Specify the alignment of the tooltip for the icon-only next/prev buttons. Can be one of: start, center, or end.

props.name: tooltipPosition
props.description: Specify the position of the tooltip for the icon-only next/prev buttons. Can be one of: top, right, bottom, or left.

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon PaginationNav rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
